title: When Recovering From Burnout, Writing Became My Therapy. And This Week My First Coding Book Turns 1 Year Old. Ask Me Anything!
why_read: A personal AMA post about burnout recovery and self-publishing a coding advice book, with no technical content to evaluate.
analysis: This is a personal reflection and promotional AMA announcement tied to the one-year anniversary of the author's self-published book on career advice for developers. It covers burnout, layoffs, and writing as therapy rather than any specific engineering topic, tool, or technique. While potentially relatable on a human level, it offers nothing technically substantive for a digest focused on engineering content.
